verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented API versioning scheme and no deprecation policy for Orama or Orama Cloud. Mentions of library releases ("Since version 1.2.0", "With Orama 3.0") only date when features arrived and are not a versioned-API or deprecation commitment. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
